title: Temperature range
hints: Without an annotation, `return [lo, hi]` is inferred as `number[]`. Write the return type yourself: a tuple of two numbers, or `undefined`.
Don't sort — `readonly` forbids it (and it would mutate the caller's data). `Math.min(...nums)` and `Math.max(...nums)` work fine on a readonly array.
function minMax(temps: readonly number[]): [number, number] | undefined { if (temps.length === 0) return undefined; return [Math.min(...temps), Math.max(...temps)]; }
